entities.name: O43488 AKR7A2
observations: Exact 359-aa sequence match to reviewed human UniProt O43488 (AKR7A2), with 100% identity and full coverage.
Aldo-keto reductase family domain PF00248 spans residues 41–346; sequence-derived mass about 39.6 kDa and pI 6.70.
Curated annotation reports NADPH-dependent succinic semialdehyde reduction to 4-hydroxybutyrate (GHB); broad aldehyde/quinone substrate activity is also reported.
